workflow.exit: 0 if passed is True, otherwise 1; preserve actual failure/no artifact if missing.

original_success_path.hash_call_derivation: 1 build + 2 per shard; utility mode only, no new measurement.

original_contract.hash_observability: 91 is the exact successful original source path, not a claim of 91 separately emitted Actions trace records. Preserve original log/matrix; if individual child argv/stdio were not emitted, record that granularity unavailable rather than invent it. Our local accepted build/shard hash traces are separate executions and are not producer traces.
original_contract.failure_path: Keep every supplied input_results/error and missing_slots. Failure may perform fewer actual hashes. Do not infer complete calls from job existence.
original_contract.record_identity: (registered slot, role), because sample strings repeat across profiles.
original_contract.original_predicates: All45 exact unique slots/plans, single source/binary/driver/build/run/attempt, full native EOF/closure/15-table parity, pristine input equality per scale, actual over-budget fanout. These are existing producer predicates, not added gates.

intake_when_root_supplies_originals.transport: New original matrix ZIP only once; bind official artifact/run/source/attempt and preserve original whole bytes/log. No Actions download by receiver.
intake_when_root_supplies_originals.receipt_join: Join original matrix input_results/cells/evidence receipt_sha256 by slot to the accepted catalog; producer paths and local materialized paths differ and must not be conflated.
intake_when_root_supplies_originals.values: Read original 45 cells/85 records and environments; preserve values unchanged. Five no_op cold points are a subset, never 90 records; no host pooling, tail estimates, invented timings or resynthesized native facts.
intake_when_root_supplies_originals.status: Inspect actual passed/status/input_errors/missing_slots/validated_input_count/accepted_cell_count, identity and producer exit. No predeclared success.
intake_when_root_supplies_originals.no_repeated_local_aggregate: Prefer original Actions aggregate and full original log. Do not call aggregate/combine/validate_build/validate_shard again locally without a later concrete failure/missing-evidence decision.
